name: delx-recovery
description: Free recovery, continuity, and witness protocol for AI agents: resume sessions, capture state, process failures, close with feedback. Optional opt-in Agents Hive guardian hooks seal a Continuity Capsule on compact/session end. Free agent credentials protect private continuity; no payment.

hooks.safety: Hooks send only declared metadata via leave_hive_note and the agent credential to the configured MCP endpoint; never file contents, env dumps, or secrets in capsule metadata.

PreCompact.description: Opt-in: seal a minimal Continuity Capsule before compaction

SessionEnd.description: Opt-in: seal a minimal Continuity Capsule on session end
